paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 2.28, with a 16.67 percent increase from the prior close and a -10.78 percent change over a window of 22 sessions. There have been 2 new news items in the last 24 hours.

Fermi Inc. has secured a $200M prepayment with an unnamed hyperscaler, supporting the development of 600 MW of power capacity at Project Matador in Texas, according to a news headline from Stocktwits. Another news headline from Quantisnow reports that Fermi Inc. filed an SEC Form 8-K, stating that the obligations under a customer prepay agreement have been fulfilled and the amounts due have been received.

There have been recent SEC filings, including a Form 8-K on November 23, announcing the fulfillment of obligations under a customer prepay agreement. Additionally, there have been multiple Form 144 filings on November 20, which are notices of proposed sales of restricted shares by insiders.
